snippet.title: Syncline – Official Trailer | Rolling-block puzzle game, out November 10
snippet.description:
Syncline is a puzzle game where you roll a whole line of cubes across a grid. Out November 10 on Steam. The free demo is playable now.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4981070/Syncline/
Play the demo in your browser: https://kcederlunddev.itch.io/syncline
Discord: https://discord.gg/eMSybcz4Km

Roll the line to every goal. Lying flat it rolls one cell at a time. Stood on end it climbs ledges, and it can drop down to pick up
cubes waiting on lower ground. Roll into a wall and the line breaks apart, and the cubes left behind wait for you to collect them. Some
blocks take your cubes, some ground breaks behind you, and some cells open the way when you cover them. The camera turns in quarter
steps, and your controls turn with it.

If you played Bloxorz or Cuboid, you'll recognize where it started.

  - Hand-made level packs, each built around a different mechanic
  - A level editor with a solver that checks a level can be beaten before you share it
  - Community packs on mod.io: browse, play and publish from inside the game
  - Keyboard and gamepad, fully rebindable
  - Windows and Linux
  - English and Swedish

  #indiegame #puzzlegame #indiedev
